title: 5/13/2025 Premarket Prep

observed_trades.notes: SOXL is a 3x semiconductor ETF; underlying given as SOXX (semis index). Breakout level 1376 at 06:23 and 49:41. Closed same day (next row). Session date taken from the video title (5/13); not spoken.

observed_trades.setup: Breakout around 291-292 as Tesla got above its 200; had a huge push and closed ~7 points above his entry.
observed_trades.quote: So, I bought Tesla, you know, 292s, 29283
observed_trades.notes: Day not stated directly; context (33:07 'Tesla on Friday ... big push right off the open') suggests the prior Friday.

principles: Respect the stop once you enter: if the stop is low of day, use low of day; do not close a position just because it closed weak (regret on AMZN and SOXL).
Progressive exposure: get traction on one or two leaders before adding more names.
Only buy a stock on a day its market/group is going up; avoid swings below the 200-day.
